C0655.title: Intrusion into Bank Information System to Steal Customer Records
C0655.summary: Since July 2022, Feng and Lu exploited online banking vulnerabilities at banks in several provinces to access and steal depositor records without authorization, then attempted to select card information for unauthorized withdrawals. The Qijiang District People's Court in Chongqing concluded the criminal case with an attached public-interest civil action, sentencing both defendants to three years and six months in prison and a fine of 20,000 yuan each, while ordering deletion of unlawfully obtained personal information and a public apology in national media.
